description: This Java class defines a configuration object for MongoDB EventSource persistence settings, including factory methods, getters, and overrides for equality, hash, and string representation.

classes.name: MongoEventSourceSettings
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating configuration settings for MongoDB-based EventSource persistence including collection names and namespace support.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MongoEventSourceSettings with explicit parameters.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Constructs an instance from a configuration object, reading collection names based on plugin IDs.

methods.name: getPersistenceIdPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for persistence IDs.

methods.name: getMetadataCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata collection.

methods.name: getJournalCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the journal collection.

methods.name: getSnapshotCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the snapshot collection.

methods.name: isSupportsNamespaces
methods.description: Indicates whether the EventSource supports namespaces.
